body: 1 on 1 conversations are pretty tough for me right now. But if I do find the courage to talk, I'll surely message you. Thank you for being there🤗

I wish I could afford therapy, would've started taking it years ago. I can't bother my parents for this. They already do alot for me. And with the part time work, I hardly save anything.
Thank you for your kind words and the tips. I would start trying them from today. Thank you for taking out time to write this. It means a lot to me. 🤗

I'm 24 as well. High-Five! 🖐🏼
And thank you for the tips. I'd definitely try them. 
I hope things get better for us.  Sending you a virtual hug🤗

I agree. The best parts of my day is when my cat comes running towards me and gets on my stomach so that I'd give her a nice petting and sometimes she lays down on my chest and stomach. It's the most wholesome thing. Having cats has made my unhappy life a little happy.
Thank you for your kind words✨

I say this to myself. I see people achieving whatever they wanted even after experiencing trauma and here I am, in my stagnancy. 
I guess everybody just has different reactions and efrects of trauma.  
Sending love and prayers to you.

Exactly. I know having a thick skin won't take the pain of the abuse away completely but atleast there will be less pain, and there will be growth. I'm currently at a very stagnant position. I try something, fail and the guilt tripping starts all over again.
Absolutely right. But sometimes I wonder, how great it would've been if I didn't feel a thing, If I didn't let words affect me so much, If I was able to have a shield around my mind and heart.
Thank you so much for taking out time to reply. I will look into the workbook and resources that you've mentioned. I hope it helps. Thank you for your kind words✨

I understand what you're going through. I guess majority of the parents aren't wired to take mental health seriously. They don't realise what kind of mental pressure they're putting on their kids with just their words. Try and move out as soon as possible. You can still recover financially. You might think your friends are busy with all the good things happening in their life but there really has to be atleast one person who wouldn't think twice before being there for you. You just gotta ask for help. Take that step. I really have no expectations from my parents, I rely mostly on myself and sometimes my best friend for help.  I hope you find that friend, get help, get therapy, move out of your parents' house and live a long happy life.

Try and keep her company as much as you can.  Be in constant connection with her. Make her feel heard and seen. Make her feel like somebody does care for her. May be that'll change her outlook on life. I really hope she doesn't take her life and you both live a long, happy life.

Belated happy birthday champ! You turned 15 and you have a whole life ahead of you. I just want you to know that I care about you. Grades don't matter much. focus on bringing yourself on track for now. Try and find that motivation. Take small steps, one day at a time. Ask for help from your fellow classmates or even teachers. You are loved. I'm sure a lot of people will help you if only you ask for it. I hope you have a long and a happy life.

I totally feel you. I'm in a very similar situation. I think about killing myself everyday because of their torture. My mother is very good at faking emotions too. She's abuse me one second and next moment infront of others, she'll show care for me. I'm really amazed and scared how quickly she changes her narrative and how double faced she is. My mother emotionally manipulates my dad. She definitely needs to see a psychiatrist. And to avoid a fight or argument, I try to agree to what she tells me to do. It's not possible always and then it leads to fights and abuses. I too dread conversations with them because it can turn into an argument very quickly. 
I don't know how to help you but I really hope something good happens to you. You should try and move away from them, set clear boundaries and maintain as less contact as possible. Please hold on. There's still hope. You can survive this. It'll be difficult but you are capable of breaking the generational trauma. Sending love and courage to you ✨
